sources.notes: Provider model ids from the NVIDIA NIM public model catalog (GET /v1/models, no authentication required).

Provider model ids, context window, max output tokens and prices from the public model list (GET /v1/openai/models, no authentication required). Despite the key names, input_tokens / output_tokens / cache_read_tokens are prices per 1M tokens. Non-token prices (per image, per character, per second of audio) are not recorded.
